immediately before the present. #: {{ux|en|We went there '''last''' year.}} #: {{ux|en|I was '''last''' to go; you're next.}} # {{lb|en|of days of the week or months of the year}} Closest in the ''before'' seven days (one week) ago. #: {{ux|en|It's Wednesday, and the party was '''last''' Tuesday; that is, not yesterday, but eight days ago.}} #: {{ux|en|When you say '''last''' Monday, do you mean the Monday just gone, or the one before that?}} #: {{ux|en|Where my brother had stood '''last''' night, I now stood.}} =====Usage notes===== * {{sense|both senses}} This cannot be used in past or future tense to refer to a time immediately before the subject matter. For example, one does not say {{m|en||I was very tired yesterday, due to not having slept well last night}}: {{m|en||last night}} in that sentence refers to the night before the speaker is speaking, not the night before the "yesterday" to which he refers. He would need to say {{m|en||I was very tired yesterday, due to not having slept well the night before}} or the like. =====Translations===== {{trans-top|the one immediately before the present}} * Albanian: * Belizean Creole: * Bulgarian: * Dutch: * Finnish: * German: * Irish: * Russian: {{t+|ru|про́шлый}}, {{t+|ru|тот}} {{q|colloquial}} {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|closest to seven days ago}} * Bulgarian: * Finnish: * German: * Romanian: {{trans-bottom}} ====Adverb==== {{en-adv|-}} # Most recently. #: {{ux|en|When we '''last''' met, he was based in Toronto.}} #* {{RQ:Shakespeare Romeo and Juliet|I|v|passage=How long is't now since '''last''' yourself and I / Were in a mask?}} # {{lb|en|sequence}} after everything else; finally #: {{ux|en|As I arrived '''last''' of all, I'll go '''last''' to add the butter '''last'''.}} #: {{ux|en|[['''last''' but not least]]}} #* {{RQ:Dryden Metamorphoses|book=X|passage=Pleased with his idol, he commends, admires, / Adores; and, '''last''', the thing adored desires.}} =====Synonyms===== * {{sense|after everything else}} {{l|en|finally}}, {{l|en|lastly}}; see also [[Thesaurus:lastly]] =====Translations===== {{trans-top|most recently}} * Czech: * Hungarian: * Polish: * Ukrainian: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|after everything else}} * Arabic: * Armenian: * Bulgarian: * Chinese: * Czech: * Finnish: * French: * German: * Greek: * Hindi: * Irish: * Italian: * Japanese: * Macedonian: * Norwegian: * Portuguese: * Romanian: * Russian: {{t|ru|по́сле всех}}, {{t|ru|в конце́}} * Serbo-Croatian: * Slovak: * Slovene: * Swedish: * Turkish: {{trans-bottom}} ===Etymology 2=== {{etymon|en|id=endure|:inh|enm:lasten>}} From {{der|en|enm|lasten}}, from {{der|en|ang|lǣstan}}, from {{der|en|gmw-pro|*laistijan}}, from {{der|en|gem-pro|*laistijaną}}.
